notes.title: Transparent Layers Update
notes.notes:
Now you can add transparent layers to your sculptures! 

Transparent layers work with all three material types, so you can have transparent metal, clay, or glowing material.

Transparent layer LoDs work differently than standard material LoDs. Instead of detail reducing away from the camera, transparent layers use a fixed detail across the entire layer. If you add more detail to a transparent layer, the entire layer will eventually reduce in LoD all at once.

Happy sculpting!

-Nathan

notes.title: SculptrVR v2.2 Update is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's been almost a year since I've updated the release branch of SculptrVR. But as many of you know, I've had regular updates to the beta branch during that whole time.

This update is HUGE. There are tons of performance improvements motivated by porting to Oculus Quest and PSVR, and well as a few new tools and other improvements. I think it's really great and I hope you all enjoy!

If you encounter any bugs or just want to stop by and say hello, please join the Discord community here: 
https://discord.gg/qEX5ZKG

<3
-Nathan

[h1]Performance Improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Overall mesh generation has been sped up by 50%
[*] Memory usage is down more than 50% and some memory leaks have been fixed
[*] File sizes are down by almost 50% (They were already so small though!)
[*] General sculpting actions are ~25% faster
[*] Exporting meshes is now 3x faster, and uses 30% less memory
[/list]

[/list]
[h1]Major Improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Explore mode is now accessed through a tab on your front hand
[*] Meshes are cleaner with fewer lumpy triangles jutting outward
[*] Better physics with particles ignoring invisible blocks and hands grabbing onto triangle-exact geometry during climbing
[*] Show more detail with fewer frame drops thanks to better sculpture management
[*] Ability to mirror your stamp brush, and stamps now work with mirror planes
[/list]
[h1]Other improvements and Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Ability to delete sculptures from within SculptrVR
[*] Ability to push up visible detail even higher in graphics settings
[*] Better layer highlighting while selecting layers in the panel
[*] Fix error in OBJ/FBX export when one layer is empty
[*] Shrink layer button pushes detail into a deeper layer and kills off any detail at the deepest level
[*] Paste brush has a snap mode
[*] Fix import CSV files and add ability to place spheres with a CSV

notes.title: Patch Notes: 4/19/2018
notes.notes:
[Edit 4/24/2018: Fixed a few more potential crashes and increased visible detail at 4/5 and 5/5 detail settings.]

The first patch after smooth addresses some stability issues and improves the Level of Detail (LoD) system. So you get better performance than before while simultaneously seeing more detail! 

We improved LoD system in three ways:
1) Reduce artifacts in the lower detail meshes.

2) Properly adjust the LoD distance falloff curve across all sculpture layers to maintain steady performance. (having many sculpture layers used to cause issues...)

3) Improve sculpting responsiveness by breaking up the meshes into finer chunks within arms reach and coarser chunks in the distance. This also usually increases total visible detail!

SculptrVR now does a much better job than the previous build at maintaining steady performance! Note that the default graphics settings are tuned for an i5 and a GTX 970. If you have better hardware, try bumping up the graphics settings!

We're still on feature freeze while we prepare for launch on PSVR. We've been working exclusively on performance and stability, but I'm itching to add some features soon! Let me know in the comments what you'd like to see and what issues you run into!

Also, please consider joining the SculptrVR Discord if you're interested in providing real time feedback and hearing about the development process:
https://discord.gg/qEX5ZKG 

Thanks and happy sculpting!

-Nathan

notes.title: Update: New Avatar Bodies, Selfie Camera, Doubled Voxel Performance
notes.notes:
Great news everyone! Your own avatar now shows up in selfies! 

We also breathed some life into your avatar bodies. As an added bonus, they look a lot better in selfies than the old bodies did :-)

Also, hot damn we doubled the performance once again! The SculptrVR engine can now handle about 12,000 sphere place/delete actions per second on an i5. That's a lot.

[h1]New Avatar Bodies[/h1]
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/WholeUniqueDodobird-size_restricted.gif[/img]

The old avatars were kind of lifeless. We took a bit of inspiration from Rec Room and made our bodies torso-only. They also get thrown around by head movements, so they feel alive!

Also, we leave them on while flying hang gliders, so your body floats behind you like a cape in the wind!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21902589/947d22aabe8ba325e570b9e9cf119d0564647722.jpg[/img]

[h1]Selfie Camera[/h1]
We fixed taking selfies, so now your avatar shows up in the screenshots! 

To encourage this self-centered behavior, we added a selfie stick mode to the camera.
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ImmenseLeanDungbeetle-size_restricted.gif[/img]

Here's the first group selfie ever taken:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21902589/cf66381a5c451fbb178ed765a0ab40250d3eb125.jpg[/img]

I was surprised by how much of a presence multiplier posing for selfies is. Both of us smiled for the picture. Both of us have strange memories of posing together on the wing of a mountain-sized flying turtle.

[h1]Improved Performance[/h1]
No picture here, but here are some statistics:

Speed:
[list][*]Load times reduced by 25%
[*]Sculpting compute times reduced by 50%
[*]Undo/Redo times reduced by 25%
[*]Read-only Actions reduced by 5-10%[/list]
Memory:
[list][*]Sculpture Memory usage reduced by 50%
[*]Peak total memory usage (during level load) reduced by 50%
[*]Typical total memory usage mid-game reduced  ~30%.[/list]

The source of all this speed and memory reduction is that we no longer compute two copies of voxels. We used to make a copy and do everything twice so that we had a read-only copy of voxels that was safe to access on the game thread. Now all CPU cores share one copy of the voxels and we use deferred garbage collection to prevent invalid memory access. We also no longer need any locks to ensure thread safety!

Anyway please build some bigger worlds to help stress test ;-)

notes.title: The (Almost) Endless Detail Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Let’s talk about performance:[/h1]
When we first demoed SculptrVR at CES 2016, a player could only sculpt for about 10 minutes before performance got so bad we had to turn off shadows. Now we’ve had artists put over 50 hours of work into a world without hitches. The only limit to world size that we know if is memory usage.

The first version of SculptrVR shared on Steam could barely handle 45 sphere placements per second. Back then, we could only let you sculpt every other frame! Now the engine can handle over 2,000 sphere placements per second, so we added high and very high detail spheres that place 4x and 16x as much detail per frame.

[h1]Here’s a timeline:[/h1]
Dec. 2015 – First prototype: 100,000 voxel limit
April 3, 2016 – Launch: 300,000 voxel limit
May 27, 2016 – First LoDs: 1,800,000 voxel limit
June 21, 2016 – First Multiplayer Release!
Sept. 10, 2016 – Copy/Paste Brush
Nov. 21, 2016 – Second LoDs: 2,500,000 voxel limit (memory and CPU bound)
Dec. 21, 2016 – Memory optimization: 3,500,000 voxel limit (CPU bound)
Jan. 21, 2017 – Third LoDs: >50,000,000 voxel limit (Memory bound)

That’s a 150x increase in maximum world detail since launch! Sculpt away!

[h1]Massive LoD(Level of Detail) overhaul is mighty and great[/h1]
The new LoD system dramatically reduces CPU and GPU overhead in large worlds.
[list]
[*]Reduced compute overhead
[*]Reduced frame drops during play and during LoD switching
[*]Many LoD settings: chunky, cubey, low, medium, high
[*]Always infinite draw distance
[*]LoDs now update even in multiplayer when another player is sculpting
[/list]

The world below has over 10 million voxels and still runs at 90fps on a min-specs PC!

[*]Full asynchronous disk access. No more frame drops for you spinning disk havers!
[*]Optimize render pipeline (save 0.2ms).
[*]Reduce overdraw geometry (save 0.2ms, and some memory).

[*]Cleared out unused assets to reduce install size.
[*]Update to UE4.14.2 from 4.13.2.

notes.title: Update: Multiplayer Heads & Massive Optimizations
notes.notes:
It's been over a month since SculptrVR has had an update. This one took a lot of work, but it's finally ready!

[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[list][*]New Sculptable heads in multiplayer!
[*]CPU performance improved by 30-50%
[*]Memory usage reduced by ~50%
[*]Polish everywhere!
[*]Multiplayer now has: brush detail & loading levels together
[/list]

[h1]Multiplayer Heads[/h1]
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/UncomfortableIckyCurassow-size_restricted.gif[/img]
Build your head in the gallery. Save it to upload it to the content server!

Bring your custom head with you into multiplayer. Other players can sculpt on your head, and you can sculpt on theirs.
You can even shoot eachother with rockets!
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/PossibleHopefulHairstreak-size_restricted.gif[/img]

[h1]Expanded CSV import Capabilities[/h1]
[list][*]CSV import now supports XYZRGB or XYZLRGBA
[*]Level 0 is smallest voxels (2mm), Level 1 is 4mm voxels, etc
[*]Level 20 is the cap (2.097152 km)
[*]XYZ is in local level coordinates, so (0,0,5,1) is actually twice as high above the floor as (0,0,5,0).
[*]A is material type. 255 is standard cement. 254 is metal. 127 is glowing. All others will (probably) be buggy.
[/list]

[h1]Other Miscellaneous New Features[/h1]
[list][*]New preview gallery with larger, easier to see previews
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/DistantSomberAnt-size_restricted.gif[/img]
[*]Can now change your brush detail in multiplayer
[*]Loading levels in multiplayer with more than 2 players
[*]New laser-based tool menu (Please give us feedback!)
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/CreativeUniqueCoot-size_restricted.gif[/img]
[*]Undo/Redo now works for on the stamp brush as well as head sculptures
[*]Multiple options for mirror window
[*]Clients can now draw on the host’s stamp brush in multiplayer
[/list]

[h1]Optimizations[/h1]
[list][*]Reduce memory usage by 50% by streaming LoDs instead of storing them
[*]Reduce loading times by 50%
[*]Speed up sculpting by 30%
[*]Reduce frame drops during sculpting and loading
[*]File saving/loading is now (finally) done on background threads
[/list]

[h1]Polish Everywhere![/h1]
[list][*]Glowing particles while adding material
[*]Brushes glow while deleting
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/LittleBlueHusky-size_restricted.gif[/img]
[*]Stronger haptics and audio effects while stretching cylinder and box previews
[*]Bouncy tool animation on sculpt-start & tool/mode switch
[*]Bouncy color picker animation
[*]Bouncy tool menu icons
[*]Simplify multiplayer joining
[*]Stamp drawing bounds to allow drawing on the world while stamp is in use
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/JollyWeepyIggypops-size_restricted.gif[/img]
[*]Text outlines to improve readability
[*]Improved sound effects
[*]New sound and haptic effects for color buttons and color customizer
[*]Haptic and visual effects for gui lasers
[*]Ambient music, haptic and visual effects while skygrabbing
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/WhichClassicBluebottle-size_restricted.gif[/img]
[*]Animated butterflies
[*]Teleport avatars show the current state of players’ head sculptures
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list][*]Stamp is much more stable in multiplayer
[*]Fix crash caused by copy/paste brush exploding memory usage
[*]Players with 4K monitors that get bad performance can turn off the mirror mode in graphics settings
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[*]Water brush can get stuck placing after switching to delete mode
[*]Clearing a world in MP doesn’t reset client locations
[*]Rockets occasionally explode in midair without colliding with any material
[*]Lobbies always list 1/16 players
[/list]

notes.title: Update: Catching Butteflies, Blending Paint, and more Multiplayer Capabilities
notes.notes:
[h1][edit Sept 30, 2016: FBX export and crash fix][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21902589/c26645f9ab2a940d57ce7d4044ec302db933e569.gif[/img]
[url=https://gfycat.com/IckyScrawnyEelelephant]https://gfycat.com/IckyScrawnyEelelephant[/url]

This update is a bit eclectic!

Let's jump straight in:

[h1]Multiplayer Undo/Redo[/h1]
You can now undo and redo changes in multiplayer! 

Strange things can happen if multiple players sculpt in the same region and try to undo/redo. The options were to either let strange things happen, or void out your undo's when there are conflicts. Tough choice..

[h1]Multiplayer Copy/Paste[/h1]
The host of an MP game now has a working copy/paste tool!

I hope we can get this working for all players eventually, but it's a super computationally difficult task. Bear with us :-)

[h1]Blending Paint Tool[/h1]
The paint brush now has a secondary mode! Hit the application button to switch to soft blending mode!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21902589/c653c422b9e1070d00f31edf77e06d29a849b7d7.jpg[/img]
[i]The difference between hard and soft paint blending modes[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21902589/23d356c2044314ea89b56159a38b0394b833c8e9.jpg[/img]
[i]The blending paint allows for much more colorful creations[/i]

[h1]Butterfly Catching[/h1]
The copy/paste tool now also acts as a butterfly catching device!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21902589/10c33ee5aaea1b7ed0fba4077c1439fc3ea8409a.jpg[/img]
[i]A sculpted net is used to coerce butterflies into a cage[/i]

Butterflies flee from your head, hands, and sculpted tool. You can use these to direct a butterfly into a sculpted cage!

[h1]Help Panels[/h1]
Each tool now has a help panel with a description of its features.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21902589/57d8becb2732df5a2c8dd669b9bb3c910d43a2ee.jpg[/img]
The panel starts small and turn to be visible in your view, so they (hopefully) won't be too distracting when you rapidly switch between tools!

[h1]Import CSV Files[/h1]
This one's a little bit technical, but we wanted users to have [i]some[/i] way of importing external data into SculptrVR.
To try this, you'll need follow these instructions:
In your game directory, in the "SculptrVR" folder, create a folder named "CSVs". In that folder, place a file named "Data.csv". 

The format of the csv file should be: One voxel per row. Each row should have x,y,z,r,g,b. X/Y should be centered around 0. Z should be greater than 0 (0 is the floor). r/g/b should range from 0 to 255.

Please let me know at info@sculptrvr.com if want to try this and get confused!

[h1]Other Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Polished 3D color customizer
[*]Wide-screen mirroring on monitors. No more black bars!
[*]Less intrusive selection boxes
[*]New water brush icon
[*]Multiplayer avatars no longer show clear cylinders for hands (why did those ever exist?)
[*]Fixed: Intermittent issues with the stamp tool after copying
[*]Fixed: GUI items oscillate if the game’s framerate drops 
[/list]

[h1]Known Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*]Multiplayer lobbies always list 1 player
[*]Changing pages or exiting out of gallery too quickly can leave residual pedestals
[/list]

If you made it this far, thank you! We've got more cool updates planned in the future!

notes.title: Update: Glowing and Shiny Materials
notes.notes:
[h1]SculptrVR just got a lot prettier![/h1]
This update brings glowing and metalic/reflective voxel types to your worlds.

[h1]Glowing Voxels[/h1]
Glowing voxels begin to emit more light as the sun sets and really bloom once the moon rises high! Don't forget you can change the time of day by pointing your teleport laser at the sun/moon and pulling the trigger.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21902589/aeeac2685286a6baf1cf0d935aeae2ccfd3ee15d.jpg[/img]
[i]An image taken of Dragon Brawl by Erica Layton[/i]

[h1]Metallic/Reflective Voxels[/h1]
Voxels can now be given a waivy, reflective surface. This works great both as shiny metal and as water.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21902589/e05e5c8669740ed0fe5c6a7695ed97ad24359149.jpg[/img]
[i]An image taken of Cloud Dojo by Erica Layton[/i]

[h1]Incredible New Demo Worlds[/h1]
There are 9 new worlds to explore as well as a brand new preview gallery!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21902589/9607e39cb487557add441a024878e1d40a5865a1.jpg[/img]

Three worlds were created by Suzanne Leibrick (inannamute): Rigel 4, Transylvania, and Shannavirra.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21902589/061a342e3937c67c73e456108b62832f353fa1b7.jpg[/img]
[i]An image taken of Shannavirra by Suzanne Leibrick[/i]

And there are six new creations from Erica Layton (@EricaLayton): Dragon Brawl, World Turtle, Jungle Block, Cloud Dojo, Hoodoo Sea, and Zebra Dragon.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21902589/8da3ba18e9a0434a17bc5b318efecf591133c418.jpg[/img]
[i]An image taken of Hoodoo Sea by Erica Layton[/i]

[h1]Other Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Loading a world from disk is ~4x faster
[*]Sculpting actions (especially at high detail) happen more quickly and feel more responsive
[*]Reduced CPU overhead of large worlds
[*]Added a screen-space reflections option in the graphics menu
[*]Many sculptures can now share one compute thread (this mostly sets us up for future planned features)
[*]New File Locations. Screenshots, saved worlds, and exported meshes are now saved in Documents/SculptrVR. Old files will be transferred to this folder on launch.
[*]Ambient light & fog color now match sky color
[*]Glowing rocket particles (VERY PRETTY)
[*]Button text has been outlined and enlarged for improved readability
[*]Menus no longer stack atop each other and are less bulky
[*]Buttons have a new voxelly look
[*]Buttons smoothly grow/shrink on selection/deselection
[*]Improved color selector based on user feedback
[*]Save/Load graphics settings
[*]Sun position now stored when you save a world
[*]Added an optional floor-platform for those of you with a fear of heights
[*]Popups for important information such as save locations
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Menu sizes will now be scaled correctly in multiplayer
[*]The teleport cage will now be scaled correctly in multiplayer
[*]Teleport scale indicator no longer reports false values in multiplayer
[*]Rockets’ explosion smoke particles now scale with rocket size
[*]Bloom graphics settings no longer get reset when moving the sun
[*]Small-scale particles no longer fall through the sculpture
[*]Saving worlds no longer inserts previously saved emitters into your newly saved world
[*]The lobby menu will now be scaled correctly at any player scale
[*]Fixed an issue with saving/loading empty worlds
[*]Fixed an issue which allowed players to join multiple multiplayer games simultaneously
[*]Fixed an issue which allowed players to prematurely exit the lobby menu
[*]Fixed a crash when exporting empty worlds
[/list]

[h1]Known Bugs in this Version[/h1]
[list]
[*]Multiplayer lobbies always list 1 player
[*]Clients can’t change emitter velocity in multiplayer
[*]Voice cuts out in mid sentence in multiplayer
[*]Changing pages or exiting out of gallery too quickly can leave residual pedestals
[/list]

[h1]Comming up next[/h1]
The Upload/share Server is at the top of our priority list. 
The public has spoken, and it wants a copy/paste tool! I just need to figure out how to make the interface..
Two minigame modes are under way!

notes.title: Multiplayer Release!
notes.notes:
Multiplayer is now released on the main branch of SculptrVR!!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21902589/1d658708c2a663cc03c739ff7e1a11fbc930cd09.jpg[/img]

Join your friends on Steam, or join strangers in a public game in SculptrVR. Build worlds together!

Here's the launch trailer: [url]https://youtu.be/8HgpL5-e1LM[/url]

During the beta, we've had the opportunity to jump into many of your worlds, explore them, play in them, and add to them. It's been incredibly fun, and I can't wait to share that experience with more people!

We've worked hard to bring down the net bandwidth per player as much as possible. This in turn allows up to 16 players (theoretically at least... we haven't yet been able to test with that many...) to join one world and create together! Currently in a 16 player game, each client only needs ~6kB/s of upload and ~50kB/s of download. The host needs 50kB/s symmetric upload/download. Not too bad!

Sculpting in SculptrVR is extremely computational. An i5 CPU is currently only capable of calculating ~200 actions per second. With 16 players connected, all sculpting at 90hz, even the fastest CPUs would be overwhelmed. To deal with this, we rate-limit your sculpting based on number of connected clients. Instead of placing a sphere every single frame, you'll only place a sphere every 8th frame. This also helps keep down the net-bandwidth!

I can't promise you that everything is perfect, but I can say it's very, very fun!

I hope to see you all in world soon!

-Nathan

Instead of placing a sphere every single frame, you'll only place a sphere every 8th frame. This also helps keep down the net-bandwidth!

I can't promise you that everything is perfect, but I can say it's very, very fun!

I hope to see you all in world soon!

-Nathan

Edit June 23, 2016: Hotfix update! There was an ambarassingly common situation where delete particles would cause multi-frame hiccups in the game. That has been fixed.

notes.title: Adaptive Detail and World Gallery Update!
notes.notes:
The latest update to SculptrVR adds two long awaited features: [b]Adaptive Detail[/b] and the [b]World Gallery[/b]!

[h1]Adaptive Detail:[/h1]

The Adaptive Detail combines far off, small voxels into larger ones. This reduces the triangle count, and allows the player to keep sculpting for a much longer time!

[h1]World Gallery:[/h1]
The World Gallery is a new way to load your saved files. A low resolution 'preview world' is created using the Adaptive Detail technology and displayed on one of 16 pedestals in the gallery. You can page through your worlds visually, 16 at a time! Each of your old worlds will need to be resaved to generate a preview.

For a more detailed description, [url=http://www.sculptrvr.com/2016/06/19/adaptive-detail-and-world-gallery-update/]click here[/url]

notes.title: Update: Position the Sun/Moon. Export color obj
notes.notes:
A new SculptrVR update has been released!

This version allows you to move the sun/moon by selecting one with your teleport laser and dragging it accross the sky. To change from night to day, simply drag the moon down to the horizon and the sun will rise on the opposite side of the land.

Exported OBJ files now include vertex colors! Not all programs support vertex colors -- most programs will simply ignore the color -- but here are a few that support it:
[list]
[*]sketchfab.com
[*]Microsoft 3D Builder (built into windows 10)
[*]i.materialise.com
[*]Meshlab (free and can convert to other formats)
[/list]

3D prints from SculptrVR models turn out great!

The undo/redo (swiping left/right in your teleport hand) now undoes batches at a time! Similar to any artistic program, undo removes strokes rather than each action individually.

I hope you all enjoy the improvements!

notes.title: SculptrVR Update Including .obj Export!
notes.notes:
Now you can build a sculpture in SculptrVR and export it as an obj file for 3D printing! The files are saved to your Steam SculptrVR folder for example: 
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\sculptrvr\SculptrVR\SculptrVRSaves

Magic smoothing is done on your hands. It smooths out the jitters in your hand motion, but only when you're trying to keep your hands still! This makes teleporting waaaay better.

When you load a saved world, you also load the postion and scale from where you were when you hit the save button. Now you can choose how others get introduced into your world!

The cube emitters no longer show their selection sphere except when the emitter brush is in hand. Now you can build a waterfall of cubes and hide those annoying transparent selection spheres :-)

Four new demo worlds to explore!
[list]
[*]Orange Tide: A pirate world with buried treasure hidden somewhere...
[*]Giza: Explore the tunnels under the Sphinx and the Pyramids!
[*]Volcano: A partial landscape with an erupting volcano and a village
[*]SculptrVR Treehouse: I really like trees :-)
[/list]

I hope you enjoy the changes! More is comming soon!
